Stories & credits

These short, child-friendly retellings introduce Hindu devotional traditions. Stories and customs vary across regions and families. The nine forms are presented in the Navadurga sequence, ending with Siddhidatri.

  • Navaratri — festival, Navadurga, and regional practices
  • The Divine India — The Story of Navratri
  • Tell-A-Tale — goddess stories and linked individual retellings

LEGO-style goddess illustrations supplied by the host. LE’Golu is a family celebration theme, with no claim of LEGO endorsement.

Background music: “Tabla drums demo” by tabladrumsonline (2012), via Wikimedia Commons. Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported. The supplied Ogg recording is unmodified; playback repeats at a reduced volume. No endorsement is implied.
